subject.title: feat(workspace): lint and auto-fix code fences in markdown at write time

question: Should OpenClaw add default write-time Markdown code-fence auto-fixing for workspace files, or should this remain a warning/tooling/plugin-style capability?
rationale: The request adds both automatic mutation of user-authored workspace Markdown and a new configuration knob, so implementation depends on maintainer intent rather than a strict bug-fix contract.

options.title: Warning-first core lint
options.body: Add a narrow warning-only diagnostic in the workspace/document write path, then require explicit maintainer approval before enabling automatic edits.

options.title: Default auto-fix in core
options.body: Implement the requested default mutation behavior with tests and a documented skip/warn policy, accepting the risk of unexpected Markdown rewrites.

options.title: Keep outside core
options.body: Leave automatic formatting to external editor tooling or a plugin/skill until a stronger core API need is demonstrated.

recommendation.title: Warning-first core lint
recommendation.body: Add a narrow warning-only diagnostic in the workspace/document write path, then require explicit maintainer approval before enabling automatic edits.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced and repeatedly refactored the central workspace/bootstrap surfaces that this feature would mutate.
